question: Can the assembled power/rear-plate unit translate straight forward into the body from the rear?
stage: Existing rear plate and eight rear bolts/eight rear washers removed. Other fixed mechanism retained and temporarily supported. Power unit includes43 mounting parts plus two conservative module envelopes.
stop: Stop at first sampled pose with a CAD overlap/clearance failure. A passing sample grid cannot prove continuous insertion; if no failure is found, continuous bounds are required.
intentional_contacts: Rear plate may touch body shroud, yaw supports and backing plates at final pose only; overlap remains forbidden.
limits: Module envelopes are not physical solids; their overlap alone is inconclusive
No temporary support jig, hands, wires, gravity or deformation
This evaluates one straight insertion route, not all possible assembly sequences
